Created [ARCH-001](/tmp/dfai-architecture-eval-kkpiuupq/project/docs/specs/architecture/ARCH-001.md) with two proposed ADRs and requirement-by-requirement readiness.

- **Draftable:** booking, coordinator roster, phone privacy, hosted infrastructure.
- **Blocked:** sign-in, Google-account support, and revocation need identity-platform evidence.
- **No implementation epic is fully ready:** mandatory compliance and accessibility criteria are missing.

Document checks passed. The approved PRD and policy remain unchanged; runtime behavior is unverified.
